purpose: PE32/PE32+ identity lane (test-estate phase 4.1, real-binary R4)
why: Shipped Windows binaries carry NO COFF symbol table -- win10-dismcore.dll has zero COFF symbols against 4 exports and 222 imports. lld-link produces the same shape, so these fixtures are the case a COFF-only resolver cannot answer at all. `imported_helper` is a real import resolved through helperN.dll's generated import library, so the IMPORT disposition is measured rather than synthesized.
